translations.web: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
translations.bsb: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
translations.kjv: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
